rules.title: California Government Code section 12955 (Housing Discrimination; source of income)
rules.requirement: Housing providers may not discriminate based on source of income, including government rent subsidies and vouchers. Where a government rent subsidy applies, income standards must be based on the tenant's portion of rent, and applicants must be allowed to offer alternative evidence of ability to pay instead of credit history. Inquiring about the level or source of income is not discrimination.
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776 (SB 267), effective January 1, 2024; in the code.

coverage.summary: Applies to owners of housing accommodations generally.

rules.quoted_span:
(o) (1) In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following:
(A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
